column1: HeavyMap dataset inventory v4 — generative control plane with doc paths

One spreadsheet is both a presence register (what each dataset is, rights, pipeline status, and documentation pointers) and a utilization / generative control plane (joins, dossier bands, UI surfaces, derived readings, and agent hooks).
Part 1 (Presence) — columns A–AX: identity, rights, coverage, pipeline, status, and the v4 documentation-path block.
Part 2 (Utilization) — columns AY–BN: joins, dossier/UI/math hooks, UK capability analogues, and agent hooks.
After repo, v4 adds docs_dir_rel, normalize_doc_rel, field_map_doc_rel, decision_doc_rel, qa_doc_rel, tests_rel, raw_cache_rel, ship_artifact_rel, related_code_rel, linear_ids, and doc_status.
Empty paths mean no dedicated document exists yet. doc_status is missing by default; agents should only create stubs when the packet says so. Paths are repo-relative.

The CSV is the source of truth. The xlsx is regenerated by scripts/rebuild_spreadsheet_workbooks.py and is never hand-edited. Header colours from earlier workbook builds are not preserved by the stdlib regenerator.
Read AGENTS-MCS.md before changing data or code. It is the shared MCS contract and explains required write-back hygiene.
v4 copies every v3 value, adds family_id blank, leaves doc paths blank unless directly obvious, sets doc_status=missing for all rows, and does not add UK geographic datasets.
Schema: 05-control-plane-column-schema.md. Canonical file: 02-dataset-inventory-v4.csv (UTF-8). The xlsx is generated.
